positive_control.training: 50000 public 9x9 mazes, 5000 updates, batch 64, fixed final EMA
positive_control.small_gate: exact path >=99% on first512 D4-disjoint and D4-unique official test9 at depths100,400,800
positive_control.ood_gate: exact path >=95% for all3 inference seeds; first256 test59 D2000 and first64 test201 D13000
positive_control.on_failure: Hold all Go experiment execution; diagnose positive control first

conditions: sizes5..19 on19x19 canvas, including long snakes
message_reference: local liberty one-hot bucket IDs, same-color orthogonal neighbor elementwise-max union
intermediate_supervision: step-aligned hand-coded union including frozen draw and initial state; not full-chain target at early steps
message_saturation: clip to [0,1], learned messages; reference is binary
id_consistency: probability disagreement between two independent draws per board; collision conflict reported separately
collision_guarantee: Only the hand-coded bucket union undercounts. Learned maximum across8 draws has no such guarantee.
sealed_hygiene: Every evaluated model must pass own >=95% small macro and stability gates; no baseline exception
depth: report D/chain stone-graph diameter, D=2 and4 times max diameter; conventions for singleton documented
cap4_extrapolation_gate: >=95% macro and >=90% pair-both-correct on all prespecified larger sizes with depths<=4diameter; all3 seeds

richer_tasks.status: paused until cap4 extrapolation gate passes
richer_tasks.eyes: repair generator diversity and class support before freezing any future set
